hero_eyebrow: A historic space with a modern spirit
hero_lede: The wedding is one night. The run-up is three or four. Den 1880 does the smaller ones too, in rooms sized for twenty people rather than a hall built for two hundred. As an engagement party venue it works the same way: one room, one bar, one team.
objection_1_q: “Is a venue overkill for twenty people?”
objection_1_a: The Library seats a long table without feeling like a rented room, and you get catering and bar service with it. Nobody has to host it out of their kitchen.
objection_2_q: “Can we book it with the wedding?”
objection_2_a: Ask about it in the same inquiry. The events team quotes the shower or rehearsal alongside the wedding date rather than as a separate conversation.
objection_3_q: “What does the room actually give us?”
objection_3_a: Four 16-foot harvest tables, a video screen, custom seating, and a bar that is already in the building. The Library starts from $1,000 per hour as an add-on to a Theatre rental, or books on its own.
occasions_heading: Three Ways To Use The Building
occasion_1_body: Afternoon in the Library. A long table, a bar that is already there, and light through the original windows.
occasion_2_body: The Lobby Bar, standing, drinks in hand, the building doing the decorating for you.
occasion_3_body: The night before, in the room your guests will walk into tomorrow. It makes the next day feel rehearsed, because it was.
gallery_heading: The Rooms, And What Happens In Them
lib_heading: The Room These Nights Happen In
lib_1_v: Four 16-foot harvest tables, custom seating and a video screen. One long table rather than a floor of round ones.
lib_2_v: From $1,000 per hour as an add-on to a Theatre rental, or booked on its own — ask for the standalone rate in your inquiry.
lib_3_v: The same kitchen and the same bar as a wedding. Nothing about the service changes because the room is smaller.
lib_4_v: Mention both in one inquiry and the events team quotes them together rather than twice.
why_1_body: An 1880 heritage building with original wood, ornate chandeliers, marble and coloured lighting. Couples arrive with flowers and a cake.
why_2_body: Venue, open bar, catering, AV, furniture, staff and parking quoted together. One team, one invoice, one point of contact.

sib_heading: The Rest Of The Wedding Pages
inquiry_body: Tell us your date and your guest count. You will hear back from the events team, usually within one business day, with a real quote rather than a starting-from figure.
inquiry_note: No commitment required, just a conversation.
